'''South Dade Senior High School''' is a [[secondary school|secondary]] school in [[unincorporated area|unincorporated]] [[Miami-Dade County, Florida]], just north of [[Homestead, Florida|Homestead]].  It is located on {{convert|60|acre|m2}} at the southernmost end of Miami-Dade County.

It is the older of the two public high schools that serves the population of parts of the city of Homestead, [[Redland, Florida|Redland]], [[Naranja, Florida|Naranja]], [[Leisure City]], and other unincorporated areas.

South Dade is currently structured as a [[magnet school]] with [[International Baccalaureate]] and five other Academic programs that draw students from throughout the region.

==History==
South Dade was established in 1953, consolidating the original Homestead High School with the agricultural program and grades 9-12 of the [[Redland Farm Life School]].<ref name="rms">{{cite web |url=https://redlandmiddle.org/m/pages/index.jsp?uREC_ID=274768&type=d|title=Redland Middle School – About Us |accessdate=2020-03-04|publisher=redlandmiddle.org}}</ref> 
Following the devastation of [[Hurricane Andrew]] in August 1992, the school building was repaired and a new science wing opened in 1995.  
In 2008, a state of the art facility with over 420,000 square feet opened.<ref>{{Cite web |title=School History – South Dade Senior High |url=https://sdshs.net/school-history/ |access-date=2024-12-08 |language=en-US}}</ref>
